blocks.text: Tsawwassen Foreclosures and Court-Ordered Sales: streets and boundaries

items.t: Tsawwassen has two land systems side by side: City of Delta land and Tsawwassen Lands. Tsawwassen First Nation (TFN) became self-governing on April 3, 2009, and keeps its own laws index.
For registry, redemption and process on the Delta side, see the ladnerforeclosuresandcourtsales note.

blocks.text: Tsawwassen Foreclosures and Court-Ordered Sales: the housing stock

items.t: On Tsawwassen Lands, the named stock is Tsawwassen Shores. Developer Aquilini Development states it was built in partnership with Tsawwassen First Nation landowners and is sold out.

blocks.text: Tsawwassen Foreclosures and Court-Ordered Sales: rules that affect buyers

items.t: A transfer on Tsawwassen Lands needs a Tsawwassen Law certificate first. Chapter 5 of the Final Agreement requires a Certificate of Transfer issued under Tsawwassen Law to be submitted to the Registrar before a fee simple transfer may be registered.
Title is registered in the British Columbia Land Title Office, with a notation that the parcel is Tsawwassen Lands, per the Final Agreement.
Only Tsawwassen First Nation can cancel an indefeasible title to a Tsawwassen Lands parcel, per the same chapter.
TFN's Land Act governs dispositions (enacted 2009, consolidated 2024).

blocks.text: Tsawwassen Foreclosures and Court-Ordered Sales: local details a buyer would not know

items.t: The online TFN laws index is not the official registry; the official registry prevails and is held at the TFN Administration Office.
A Boundary Bay seawall crest must be 4.1 metres Geodetic Survey of Canada datum, per Delta's seawall form.
Tsawwassen's exchange is the South Delta Exchange on 56 Street, per TransLink's 601 timetable.

blocks.text: Tsawwassen Foreclosures and Court-Ordered Sales: costs and taxes

items.t: Delta-side utilities are Delta's: the 2026 flat rate total for a single-family home is $1,658.
TFN has its own Property Taxation Act, listed in the Nation's laws index.

blocks.text: Tsawwassen Foreclosures and Court-Ordered Sales: getting around

items.t: The 602 bus serves Tsawwassen Heights to Bridgeport Station via 56 Street (South Delta Exchange), Highway 17, Highway 17A and Highway 99, per TransLink's timetable.

blocks.text: Tsawwassen Foreclosures and Court-Ordered Sales: risks and due diligence

items.t: Read the title notation: it records conditions and reservations in favour of Tsawwassen First Nation.
Check the seawall permit area on waterfront lots; Delta requires engineer certification of a seawall's integrity.
Confirm which government taxes the parcel: TFN on Tsawwassen Lands, Delta on the Delta side.

faq.q: Does a court-ordered sale work the same on Tsawwassen Lands?
faq.a: Not exactly, because the title step differs. Registration stays in the British Columbia Land Title Office, but a fee simple transfer first needs a Certificate of Transfer under Tsawwassen Law. Have a lawyer confirm how a court order interacts with that requirement.

faq.q: Who makes land law on Tsawwassen Lands?
faq.a: Tsawwassen First Nation, through its Legislature. The Nation became self-governing on April 3, 2009, and the official Registry of Tsawwassen Laws is held in hard copy at the TFN Administration Office. Delta's zoning bylaw does not govern these parcels, and neither does Delta council act as the land-use authority for Tsawwassen Lands.

faq.q: Is a Tsawwassen Lands home in the Speculation and Vacancy Tax area?
faq.a: No, treaty lands are excluded. The Province lists Delta as a taxable area, then states reserve lands, treaty lands and lands of self-governing Indigenous Nations are not part of the taxable areas. A Delta-side Tsawwassen home and a Tsawwassen Lands home therefore sit on opposite sides of that tax line.

faq.q: What is a Tsawwassen Fee Simple Interest?
faq.a: It is the individual fee simple holding created under TFN's Land Act. The Final Agreement requires a Certificate of Transfer under Tsawwassen Law before it can be transferred at the Land Title Office. Permitted transferees are TFN law, not Delta rules.
